application: Official YouTube iOS app; app version not recorded
topology: iPhone Wi-Fi proxy -> Mac Python CONNECT router -> Mac Swift HTTPS proxy and rewriting engine

configuration.authority: Existing per-test authority, manually trusted on iPhone

observations.userReport: Videos start without ads after reopening YouTube and selecting different videos.
observations.screenshot: One locally retained screenshot showed the official YouTube player without a visible ad label.

limitations: Single short session, not a controlled ad-impression experiment.
Prefetches and retries mean response counts are not video or prevented-ad counts.
Three upstream_failed events cannot be distinguished from navigation cancellations in this revision.
No autonomous on-device proxy, lock/resume, cellular, battery, or memory validation.
Raw traffic and personal screenshots remain private and are not included.
